description: Lightweight Qt/QML application launcher for Windows with a global Alt+Space hotkey and Start Menu application discovery.
notes: Review status: the upstream project currently publishes v0.1 as a pre-release and provides only Pulse-Setup-0.1.exe for Windows.
The SHA-256 is taken from the GitHub Release asset digest.

The installer engine and extracted application layout have not been verified. This manifest intentionally downloads the setup file only; it does not execute the installer, register the application, or create an unverified shortcut.
Do not classify this manifest as Portable or use it as a completed Scoop installation until the installer is inspected and the application launch and uninstall behavior are verified.
